label: Small Biotech IND — CMC Drug Product (3.2.P)
description: Module 3.2.P Drug Product for NovaTide-1 lyophilized powder for injection.

inputs.dp_components_rationale: Histidine buffer selected for optimal pH stability (pH 6.0). Sucrose provides lyoprotection and isotonicity upon reconstitution. PS80 prevents surface adsorption and aggregation during processing.
inputs.formulation_development: Formulation optimized through DoE screening of buffer systems (pH 5.5–6.5), sucrose concentration (5–15%), and PS80 levels (0.01–0.05%). Lyophilization cycle developed with conservative primary drying at -25 °C shelf temperature. Reconstitution time < 60 seconds with WFI.
inputs.process_development: Aseptic fill-finish at Baxter BioPharma Solutions. Scale-up from 500 vial to 10,000 vial batches demonstrated with comparable quality attributes.
inputs.dp_container_closure: 13 mL Type I borosilicate glass vial, 20 mm FluroTec® coated lyophilization stopper, aluminum crimp seal
inputs.dp_process_flow: Thaw DS → Buffer exchange/dilute → 0.2 µm filtration → Aseptic fill → Lyophilization → Stoppering → Crimping → Visual inspection → Labeling → Packaging
inputs.dp_cpp: Fill volume (±2%), lyophilization shelf temperature, chamber pressure, primary drying time
inputs.dp_ipc: Pre-filtration bioburden, filter integrity, fill weight check, cake appearance
inputs.excipient_control_summary: All excipients comply with USP/NF and/or Ph.Eur. monographs. Certificates of analysis obtained from qualified suppliers. No novel excipients.
inputs.dp_appearance_spec: White to off-white lyophilized cake; clear to slightly opalescent upon reconstitution
inputs.dp_diss_spec: Complete dissolution in ≤ 60 seconds in 1.0 mL WFI
inputs.dp_micro_spec: Sterile per USP <71>; endotoxin ≤ 5.0 EU/mg per USP <85>
inputs.dp_reference_standards: Same as drug substance reference standards (NVT-RS-001, NVT-WS-001)
inputs.dp_final_container: 13 mL Type I borosilicate glass vial with FluroTec® coated stopper
inputs.dp_ac_result: Slight increase in aggregates (2.1%); within spec
inputs.dp_shelf_life: 24 months at 2–8 °C (proposed; supported by 12-month real-time data)
